{{Quote|You're talking about the Godera laboratory...?|Paril|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Paril''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]] and provided [[Cipher Nine]] information on the whereabouts of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]].
